title: A Midsummer Night s Dream
librettist: Benjamin Britten and Peter Pears based on the play by Shakespeare
premiere: Jubilee Hall, Aldeburgh Festival on 11 June 1960

synopsis.text:
Set to a libretto adapted from the Shakespeare play by himself and his partner Peter Pears, Britten's work is rare in operatic history in that it features a countertenor in the male lead role.
